detail.longDescription: Today in "weird shit Kubernetes does": did you know that if you try to do an in-place resize for a pod, the result can be one of three states? Those states are "yes, did it", "nope, sorry, can't fit", and "well it can't fit RIGHT NOW, but it might fit sometime in the far distant future, so I'm just gonna sit here forever and hope" (The technical term for the last state is "Deferred", in case you're curious) # kubernetes # k8s # scheduling # devops
